title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)

messages.subject: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: part:370010 – price basis from 2027-01-01
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your offer and letter. Our orders with you for part:370010 rose from EUR 5.26 (po:4500013373-10) to EUR 5.84 (po:4500014427-10) between 2026-01-02 and 2026-09-18. That rise is already in our price. AS-14404 fell from 3182.6744 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06) to 3007.8019 (idx:AS-14404@2026-09), a change of -5.49%. PPI-C2431 fell from 131.9 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05) to 129.1 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08), a change of -2.12%.

We would like to give you planning security with a longer commitment of 23,700 kg per year over 24 or 36 months, with a fixed price and no surcharge clause, which also removes the monthly recalculation workload. Our attached term sheets reflect this. Could you also tell us the earliest lead time you can confirm?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: part:370010 – price basis from 2027-01-01
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. Specifically, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains.

We welcome the proposed 24-month commitment for 23,700 kg per year and have lowered our price to €5.30 per unit in response to the index developments you cited. Our updated Angebot is a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Please note that we must include the AS-14404 index clause for a 24-month contract, as a fixed price over this duration is not feasible. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.30 per unit.

Our colleagues will address your question regarding the earliest confirmable lead time separately. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Logistics: Please note that our standard Lieferzeit is 14 days, as we currently have free capacity for your parts. With overtime we can also deliver in 14 days, though this option comes at a premium.

messages.subject: Part 370010 – fixed-price package for 24 months
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your revised offer and for welcoming the 24-month commitment.

The forecast for part:370010 increased by 1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

We have moved our price on the attached term sheet. It covers 23,700 kg per year over 24 months with payment at 60 days. We prefer a fixed price without the surcharge clause. This gives both sides a stable basis and removes the monthly surcharge recalculation for your team and ours.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Part 370010 – fixed-price package for 24 months
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. As previously stated, a fixed price over 24 months is not feasible, and we must insist on the AS-14404 index clause to manage raw material risks. With the index clause included, we are prepared to lower our offer to €5.10 per unit for a 24-month commitment and 60-day payment terms. Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.10 per unit. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.

Our current offer stands at a price of €5.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: part:370010 - revised term sheet, 24-month commitment
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your revised offer.

On volume, our term sheet commits 23,700 kg per year over 24 months, which is 47,400 kg in total, with payment at 60 days.

We have made a clear step towards you on price in the attached term sheet. We would still prefer a fixed price. A fixed price gives your team a firm basis for the full term and removes the monthly surcharge recalculation on both sides.

Could you tell us whether this package works for you? Could you also tell us the earliest lead time you can confirm?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: part:370010 - revised term sheet, 24-month commitment
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for reaching out. We appreciate your revised offer; however, a fixed price over 24 months remains unfeasible, and we must insist on the AS-14404 index clause. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our offer remains valid for 7 days.

Under our main offer, with the index clause included, we are prepared to lower our price to €4.90 per unit for the 24-month commitment and 60-day payment terms. For this option, our offer stands at a price of €4.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Please provide the binding volume figures you referenced so we can verify this commitment. Which volume can you commit to?

Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.00 per unit. This alternative option offers a price of €5.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Logistics: Please note that our standard Lieferzeit is 14 days, as we currently have free capacity for your parts. With overtime we can also deliver in 14 days, though this option comes at a premium.
